headline: Safra Downgrades Brazilian Banks Amid Recession Risks
summary: Safra has downgraded its recommendations for Itaú, Bradesco, and Banco do Brasil, citing risks of an economic recession in 2027. The report highlights high interest rates, slowing credit demand, and increased default risks.
why: Banking sector performance is a bellwether for the Brazilian economy; analyst downgrades can influence institutional capital allocation.
